question.problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -2 \\ -2 & -1 & 5 \\ 0 & 3 & 4\end{aligned}]
$$

If $A=LU$ is the LU decomposition of the matrix $A$ given above, what is the value of ${l}_{31}\cdot {u}_{23}?$
question.worked_solution:
Let's apply our standard LU factorization algorithm.

We reduce the matrix $A$ to row echelon form to obtain the matrix $U,$ as usual. However, instead of writing zeros below the main diagonal, we will instead write down the entries of the matrix $L.$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -2 \\ -2 & -1 & 5 \\ 0 & 3 & 4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -2 \\ -2 & -3 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 & 4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+1{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -2 \\ -2 & -3 & 1 \\ \,\,0\,\, & -1 & 5\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
L=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}],\,U=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & -3 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 5\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, since ${l}_{31}=0$ and ${u}_{23}=1,$ we get

$$
{l}_{31}\cdot {u}_{23}=0\cdot 1=0.
$$
